description: Every enabled level-55 root skill has an icon and an effect, plot, or controller execution graph.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skills skill WHERE skill.id IN (23587, 23588, 23589, 23934, 23591, 23592, 23593, 23594, 23595, 23596) AND skill.icon_id > 0 AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skill_effects effect WHERE effect.skill_id = skill.id) OR COALESCE(skill.plot_id, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(skill.skill_controller_id, 0) > 0);
